features.description: HPOA frequency of the term in the disease profile (ADR-0007 estimate); 0 when unknown; unknown_value folds in the frequency_unknown indicator
features.name: frequency

features.description: -ln((a + 1) / (D + 1)); a = diseases in the masked KB annotating the term or a descendant, D = diseases in the KB (terms.annotated_diseases, annotation_diseases)
features.name: information_content

features.description: number of strict is_a ancestors of the term in HPO (terms.ancestors)
features.name: ancestor_count

features.description: ln((c + 1) / (N + 1)); c = R1-train patients reporting the term or a descendant, N = R1-train patients (terms.reportability, reportability_patients). While fitting, c and N leave out the scored patient's publication group
features.name: log_reportability

features.description: 1 if (disease, term) is a cardinal-v1 row, else 0
features.name: cardinal

notes: Fitted with ADR-0007 frequencies from the masked KB; the simulator scores its own merged, shrunk frequencies. Ancestor counts assume HPO 2026-02-16.

cardinal_flag.fit_rule: rows resting on any R1 publication or on R1-train recounts are left out while fitting, so the flag carries no information from the scored patients' papers

fit.note: log loss and AUC use leave-publication-out reportability; the within-gene rho uses full R1-train reportability, so it is in-sample and optimistic. Out-of-sample: dxt sim report-model-check (R1-dev).

within_gene_rho_r1_train_in_sample.frequency: P(term | gene): disease-weight mixture of the masked KB's known frequencies

term_budget.definition: number of present (reported) terms per R1-train case

provenance.unit: (R1-train patient, phenotypic-abnormality term of the patient's disease profile in kb-v4, OMIM and exactly aligned ORPHA ids merged); label 1 if the patient reports the term or a descendant of it

term_budget.description: number of present (reported) terms per R1-train case
